source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 25 (PDF 228-246), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Ecology) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The study of the relationships of organisms with other organisms and with the environment is called:
(Jandaron ke doosre jandaron aur mahol ke saath talluqaat ke mutalie ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: ecology (mahooliyat) jandaron ke doosre jandaron aur mahol ke saath talluqaat ka mutalia hai.

book_ref.quote: Ecology is the study of the relationships of organisms with other organisms and the environment

blocks.prompt:
2 The basic unit of biological classification is the:
(Biological classification ki bunyadi ikai kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: species biological classification (darja bandi) ki bunyadi ikai hai.

book_ref.quote: A species is the basic unit of biological classification

blocks.prompt:
3 According to the definition of a species, its members, most importantly:
(Species ki tareef ke mutabiq is ke members sab se ahem taur par:)

options.text: aapas mein mil kar fertile aulad paida kar sakte hain
aik hi geographic ilaqe mein rehte hain
hamesha bilkul aik jaise dikhte hain

blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: species ke members milti julti jismani aur genetic khususiyaat rakhte hain aur sab se ahem yeh ke aapas mein mil kar zarkhez (fertile) aulad paida kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: can interbreed to produce fertile offspring

blocks.prompt:
4 The book's example of a distinct species, whose members cannot breed with other types of dolphins to produce fertile young, is the:
(Kitab mein alag species ki misaal jo doosri qisam ki dolphins se fertile bachay paida nahi kar sakti:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: Indus River Dolphin alag species hai; Indus dolphins aapas mein nasl barhati hain, doosri dolphins ke saath fertile bachay nahi.

book_ref.quote: The Indus River Dolphin is a distinct species

blocks.prompt:
5 A group of individuals of the same species living in the same geographic area at the same time is a:
(Aik hi species ke afraad ka group jo aik hi ilaqe mein aik hi waqt rehta ho:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: yeh population (aabadi) ki tareef hai.

book_ref.quote: A population is a group of individuals belonging to the same species living in the same geographic area at the same time

blocks.prompt:
6 All the Markhors living in the Chitral Gol National Park form a:
(Chitral Gol National Park mein rehne wale tamam Markhor kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: Chitral ke Markhor aik population hain; poore Pakistan ke Markhor species kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: all the Markhors living in the Chitral Gol National Park form a single population

blocks.prompt:
7 All the different populations of various species living and interacting in the same area make up a:
(Aik hi ilaqe mein rehne aur aapas mein amal karne wali mukhtalif species ki tamam populations kya banati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: community (jamaat) aik ilaqe ki mukhtalif species ki tamam populations par mushtamil hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A community consists of all the different populations of various species living and interacting in the same area

blocks.prompt:
8 In the book's example of a community, the Mangrove trees, mudskipper fish, crabs and shorebirds belong to a mangrove forest in:
(Community ki misaal mein Mangrove darakht, mudskipper, kekray aur sahili parinde kahan ke mangrove forest mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: Karachi ka Mangrove Forest community ki misaal hai.

book_ref.quote: a Mangrove Forest in Karachi refers to a community

blocks.prompt:
9 In an ecosystem:
(Ecosystem mein:)

options.text: energy aur nutrients dono cycle karte hain
nutrients aik taraf, energy cycle karti hai
energy aur nutrients dono aik taraf behte hain
energy aik taraf behti hai, nutrients cycle karte hain

blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: energy aik taraf behti hai jab ke nutrients zinda aur ghair zinda hisson ke darmiyan cycle karte hain.

book_ref.quote: In an ecosystem, energy flows unidirectionally while the nutrients cycle between the living and the non-living parts

blocks.prompt:
10 In the Thar Desert example of an ecosystem, which is an abiotic factor?
(Thar Desert ecosystem ki misaal mein abiotic (ghair zinda) factor kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: saanp, blackbuck aur jhaariyan community hain; sakht garmi, sarakte ret ke teele aur kam barish abiotic factors hain.

book_ref.quote: the Thar Desert is a vast ecosystem

blocks.prompt:
11 A large, distinct geographical region characterized by its specific climate, soil, altitude and adapted plants and animals is a:
(Bara, alag geographic ilaqa jo apni khaas aab-o-hawa, mitti, bulandi aur mutabiq paudon aur janwaron se pehchana jaye:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: yeh biome ki tareef hai.

book_ref.quote: A biome is a large, distinct geographical region characterized by its specific climate

blocks.prompt:
12 In Pakistan, the Coniferous Forest Biome is located in:
(Pakistan mein Coniferous Forest Biome kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: Coniferous Forest Biome Murree aur Swat ke buland ilaqon mein hai jahan sard sardiyan aur pine ke darakht hain.

book_ref.quote: Coniferous Forest Biome is located in the high-altitude areas of Murree and Swat

blocks.prompt:
13 The highest and most inclusive level of ecological organization is the:
(Ecological organization ki sab se oonchi aur sab se jame satah kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: biosphere sab se oonchi aur jame satah hai; yeh tamam biomes ka aalmi majmua hai.

book_ref.quote: The biosphere is the highest and most inclusive level of ecological organization

blocks.prompt:
14 The biosphere is often called the:
(Biosphere ko aksar kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.1: biosphere ko 'Global Ecosystem' kaha jata hai, aik patla ghilaf jahan zameen, paani aur hawa milte hain.

book_ref.quote: The biosphere is often called the "Global Ecosystem"

blocks.prompt:
15 Biogeochemical cycles are the cyclic movements of chemical elements between:
(Biogeochemical cycles kimiyai anasir ki kin ke darmiyan chakkar dar harkat hain?)

options.text: ecosystem ke biotic aur abiotic hisse

blocks.explanation: Section 25.2: yeh carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus jaise anasir ki zinda aur ghair zinda hisson ke darmiyan chakkar dar harkat hain.

book_ref.quote: between the living (biotic) and non-living (abiotic) components of ecosystem

blocks.prompt:
16 A massive component of the biosphere where an element of a biogeochemical cycle is stored for long periods is called a:
(Biosphere ka bara hissa jahan kisi cycle ka element lambe arse tak jama rehta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2: primary reservoir ('sink' ya 'pool') element ko lambe arse tak jama rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: A primary reservoir ("sink" or "pool") is a massive component of the biosphere

blocks.prompt:
17 Which is a sedimentary cycle?
(In mein se kaun sa sedimentary cycle hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2: sedimentary cycles (reservoir: zameen ki parat) mein phosphorus, sulfur aur calcium cycles shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Sedimentary cycles, in which the reservoir is Earth’s crust

blocks.prompt:
18 In gaseous cycles, the primary reservoir is:
(Gaseous cycles mein primary reservoir kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2: gaseous cycles (nitrogen, oxygen, carbon, water) mein reservoir hawa ya samandar hai.

book_ref.quote: Gaseous cycles, in which the reservoir is the air or the oceans

blocks.prompt:
19 The hydrological cycle is another name for the:
(Hydrological cycle kis cycle ka doosra naam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: water cycle (hydrological cycle) paani ki abiotic aur biotic hisson ke darmiyan musalsal harkat hai.

book_ref.quote: The water cycle (hydrological cycle) is the continuous movement of water

blocks.prompt:
20 The entire water cycle is powered by:
(Poora water cycle kis se chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: suraj poora water cycle chalata hai; suraj ki shuaen paani garam kar ke bhaap banati hain.

book_ref.quote: The sun powers the entire water cycle

blocks.prompt:
21 About what percentage of global evaporation occurs from the oceans?
(Aalmi evaporation ka taqreeban kitna feesad samandaron se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: aalmi evaporation (bukharat) ka taqreeban 86% samandaron se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: About 86% of global evaporation occurs from the oceans

blocks.prompt:
22 In Pakistan, the massive primary source of vapor that travels inland is the:
(Pakistan mein bhaap ka bara bunyadi zariya jo andar ki taraf jata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: Arabian Sea Pakistan ke liye bhaap ka bara bunyadi zariya hai.

book_ref.quote: the Arabian Sea serves as the massive primary source of vapor

blocks.prompt:
23 During condensation, clouds form when droplets:
(Condensation mein badal kaise bante hain?)

options.text: hawa ke gard ke zarron se chimat jate hain

blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: bhaap oopar ja kar thandi ho kar qatre banati hai jo hawa ke gard ke zarron se chimat kar badal banate hain.

book_ref.quote: These droplets cling to dust particles in the air to form clouds

blocks.prompt:
24 Sleet is:
(Sleet kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: sleet barf ya olon mili barish hai, precipitation ki aik shakal.

book_ref.quote: sleet (a rain mingled with snow or hail)

blocks.prompt:
25 The unconfined flow of water over the land surface when it can no longer infiltrate the soil is:
(Zameen ki satah par paani ka khula behao jab woh mitti mein jazb na ho sake:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: surface runoff nadi naalon, daryaon aur aakhir samandar mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the unconfined flow of water over the land surface

blocks.prompt:
26 In Pakistan, infiltration:
(Pakistan mein infiltration kya karta hai?)

options.text: seedha Indus ko paani deta hai
peene ke paani ke aquifers bharta hai

blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: surface runoff Indus ko paani deta hai jab ke infiltration zair-e-zameen paani (aquifers) ko bharta hai.

book_ref.quote: In Pakistan, surface runoff feeds the Indus River, while infiltration recharges the aquifers

blocks.prompt:
27 The major exit point of water from plants into the abiotic environment is:
(Paudon se paani ke abiotic mahol mein wapas jane ka bara rasta:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: transpiration bara rasta hai; paude patton ke stomata se bhaap chhorte hain.

book_ref.quote: Transpiration in plants is the major exit point for water

blocks.prompt:
28 Water produced as a byproduct of respiration in plants and animals is called:
(Paudon aur janwaron mein respiration ke zimni paidawar ke taur par banne wala paani:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.1: respiration se zimni taur par paani banta hai; yeh metabolic water bhaap ki shakal mein bahar nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: This "metabolic water" is exhaled as vapors

blocks.prompt:
29 Nitrogen gas makes up about what percentage of the atmosphere?
(Nitrogen gas atmosphere ka taqreeban kitna feesad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: nitrogen atmosphere ka taqreeban 78% hai.

book_ref.quote: about 78% of our atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
30 Plants cannot use atmospheric N₂ directly because its atoms are joined by a:
(Paude N₂ ko seedha istemal nahi kar sakte kyun ke is ke atoms jure hote hain:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: N₂ ke atoms mazboot triple bond se jure hain jise paude nahi tor sakte.

book_ref.quote: Its atoms are joined by a strong triple bond

blocks.prompt:
31 Conversion of N₂ into inorganic compounds like ammonia (NH₃) is called:
(N₂ ko ammonia (NH₃) jaise inorganic compounds mein badalna kehlata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: nitrogen fixation N₂ ko NH₃ jaise compounds mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen fixation is the process of converting N₂ into inorganic compounds like ammonia (NH₃)

blocks.prompt:
32 Which is a free-living (non-symbiotic) nitrogen-fixing organism?
(In mein se kaun sa azad (non-symbiotic) nitrogen fix karne wala jandar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: azad fixers mein cyanobacteria, Azotobacter aur Clostridium hain; Rhizobium symbiotic hai.

book_ref.quote: free-living (non-symbiotic) organisms (e.g., cyanobacteria or blue-green algae, Azotobacter, and Clostridium)

blocks.prompt:
33 Rhizobium fixes nitrogen while living in the:
(Rhizobium kahan reh kar nitrogen fix karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: Rhizobium daalon (legumes) jaise Chana aur Moong ki jaron ki gaanthon (root nodules) mein rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: mutualistic (symbiotic) bacteria (e.g., Rhizobium) present in the root nodules

blocks.prompt:
34 In atmospheric fixation, the energy to combine nitrogen with oxygen comes from:
(Atmospheric fixation mein nitrogen ko oxygen se milane ki energy kahan se aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: barish aur toofan mein bijli N₂ ko O₂ se mila kar nitrogen oxides aur phir nitrates banati hai.

book_ref.quote: lightning provides the massive energy needed to combine atmospheric nitrogen with oxygen

blocks.prompt:
35 Atmospheric fixation fixes only about:
(Atmospheric fixation se sirf taqreeban kitni nitrogen fix hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: bijli se sirf thori (5-10%) nitrogen fix hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Only a small amount (5-10%) of nitrogen is fixed in this way

blocks.prompt:
36 The synthesis of nitrogen-containing fertilizers by combining atmospheric nitrogen and hydrogen is called:
(Atmospheric nitrogen aur hydrogen mila kar nitrogen wali khaad banana kehlata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: industrial fixation mein nitrogen aur hydrogen mila kar ammonia banti hai.

book_ref.quote: The synthesis of nitrogen containing fertilizers is called industrial fixation

blocks.prompt:
37 Nitrosomonas converts:
(Nitrosomonas kis ko kis mein badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: nitrification mein Nitrosomonas ammonia ko nitrite (NO₂⁻) mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Nitrosomonas convert ammonia to nitrite (NO₂⁻)

blocks.prompt:
38 The bacterium that converts nitrite (NO₂⁻) to nitrate (NO₃⁻) is:
(Nitrite ko nitrate mein badalne wala bacterium:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: Nitrobacter nitrite ko nitrate banata hai jo paude aasani se jazb karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Nitrobacter convert this nitrite to Nitrate (NO₃⁻)

blocks.prompt:
39 Absorption of nitrates by plants and microbes to make proteins, DNA and chlorophyll is:
(Paudon aur microbes ka nitrates jazb kar ke proteins, DNA aur chlorophyll banana:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: assimilation nitrogen ka zinda duniya mein dakhla hai.

book_ref.quote: plants and microbes absorb nitrates from the soil and use them to make proteins, DNA and chlorophyll

blocks.prompt:
40 Decomposers converting organic nitrogen of dead bodies and wastes back into ammonia is called:
(Decomposers ka murda jismon aur fuzla ki organic nitrogen ko wapas ammonia banana:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: ammonification recycling ka qadam hai jo fungi aur bacteria karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They convert the organic nitrogen back into Ammonia

blocks.prompt:
41 Denitrification, the return of N₂ to the air, takes place mainly in:
(Denitrification zyada tar kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: paani bhari mitti mein denitrifying bacteria (Pseudomonas, Thiobacillus) nitrates ko N₂ banate hain.

book_ref.quote: In waterlogged soils, denitrifying bacteria

blocks.prompt:
42 Thiobacillus takes part in the nitrogen cycle by converting:
(Thiobacillus nitrogen cycle mein kya badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.2.2: Thiobacillus denitrifying bacterium hai jo nitrates ko wapas N₂ banata hai.

book_ref.quote: convert nitrates back into Nitrogen gas (N₂)

blocks.prompt:
43 Unlike the cycling of matter, the flow of energy in an ecosystem is:
(Maadde ki cycling ke bar-aks energy ka behao kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3: energy ka behao aik taraf (unidirectional) hai.

book_ref.quote: unlike the cycling of matter, the flow of energy is unidirectional

blocks.prompt:
44 Different feeding groups of organisms in an ecosystem are known as:
(Ecosystem mein jandaron ke khurak ke mukhtalif groups kehlate hain:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.1: khurak ke groups trophic levels kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: the organisms are arranged in different feeding groups, known as trophic levels

blocks.prompt:
45 Trophic level 1 consists of:
(Trophic level 1 mein kaun hain?)

options.text: sabz paude, algae aur photosynthetic bacteria

blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.1: trophic level 1 primary producers hain.

book_ref.quote: Trophic level 1 consists of green plants, algae and photosynthetic bacteria

blocks.prompt:
46 A rabbit feeding directly on producers belongs to trophic level:
(Producers ko seedha khane wala khargosh kis trophic level par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.1: trophic level 2 primary consumers (herbivores) hain, maslan keeray, khargosh.

book_ref.quote: Trophic level 2 consists of primary consumers (herbivores)

blocks.prompt:
47 Besides secondary consumers (carnivores), trophic level 3 also includes:
(Secondary consumers ke ilawa trophic level 3 mein aur kaun shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.1: trophic level 3 mein secondary consumers aur herbivores par palne wale parasites hain, maslan mendak, saanp.

book_ref.quote: and the parasites of animals which feed on the herbivores

blocks.prompt:
48 Which is the book's example of a tertiary consumer?
(Kitab mein tertiary consumer ki misaal:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.1: trophic level 4 tertiary consumers hain, maslan bheriya, baaz.

book_ref.quote: Trophic level 4 consists of tertiary consumers (animals that eat carnivores)

blocks.prompt:
49 Detritus is:
(Detritus kya hai?)

options.text: murda, gal-sar raha paudon aur janwaron ka maadda

blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.1: decomposers aur detritivores detritus (murda gal-sar raha maadda) aur fuzla khate hain.

book_ref.quote: They consume detritus (dead, decomposing plant and animal material), and fecal matter

blocks.text: 25.3.2 The Loss of Energy between Trophic Levels

blocks.prompt:
50 About how much of the solar energy falling on producers is converted to bond-energy of organic matter?
(Producers par girne wali suraj ki energy ka kitna hissa organic maadde ki bond energy banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.2: suraj ki energy ka sirf 1 se 2% producers bond energy mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: About 1 to 2% of the solar energy that falls on a first trophic level

blocks.prompt:
51 An ecosystem generally has:
(Aam taur par ecosystem mein kitne trophic levels hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.2: aam taur par teen ya chaar trophic levels hote hain.

book_ref.quote: There are generally three or four trophic levels in an ecosystem

blocks.prompt:
52 If producers fix 10,000 kcal, tertiary consumers gain about:
(Agar producers 10,000 kcal fix karein to tertiary consumers ko taqreeban kitni milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.2: 10,000 → 1,000 → 100 → 10 kcal tertiary consumers ko.

book_ref.quote: If tertiary consumers eat secondary consumers, they gain about 10 kcal

blocks.prompt:
53 Short food chains are more energy efficient than long ones because:
(Chhoti food chains lambi chains se zyada energy efficient kyun hain?)

options.text: har level par energy barhti hai
energy wapas producers tak cycle karti hai
har transfer par energy hararat ban kar zaya hoti hai, kam qadam kam nuqsan

blocks.explanation: Section 25.3.2: har transfer par energy hararat ban kar zaya hoti hai, is liye kam qadam zyada efficiency.

book_ref.quote: Short food chains (with a smaller number of trophic levels) are more energy efficient

blocks.prompt:
54 The statistical study of the characteristics of populations is:
(Populations ki khususiyaat ka shumariyati mutalia:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: demography populations ka shumariyati mutalia hai.

book_ref.quote: Demography is the statistical study of the characteristics of populations

blocks.prompt:
55 The most important feature of demography, directly related to a population's ability to survive, is:
(Demography ki sab se ahem khususiyat jo population ke bachne ki salahiyat se juri hai:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: population size sab se ahem hai kyun ke yeh seedha bachne se juri hai.

book_ref.quote: Population size is the most important features of demography

blocks.prompt:
56 The percentage of members of a group that are alive at a given age is:
(Kisi group ke members ka feesad jo aik khaas umar par zinda hon:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: yeh population survivorship hai jo survivorship curves se dikhai jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Population survivorship is the percentage of members of a group that are alive at a given age

blocks.prompt:
57 In which survivorship type do most individuals live their potential life span and then die rapidly in old age?
(Kis survivorship type mein aksar afraad poori umar jeete aur phir burhape mein tezi se marte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: Type I (convex), maslan insan aur mammals.

book_ref.quote: Humans’ and mammals’ populations make type I survivorship

blocks.prompt:
58 Birds, lizards and rodents show which survivorship curve?
(Parinde, chhipkaliyan aur rodents kaun si survivorship curve dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: Type II mein poori zindagi maut ka imkan barabar rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: individuals have a constant probability of death throughout their lives

blocks.prompt:
59 Very high juvenile mortality but much lower adult mortality is shown by:
(Bachpan mein bohat zyada aur jawani mein kam sharah-e-amwat kis mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: Type III (concave) curves machhliyan aur bohat se invertebrates dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: individuals experience very high juvenile mortality rates

blocks.prompt:
60 In the exponential growth model the population:
(Exponential growth model mein population:)

options.text: har nasl mein muqarrar tadaad jorti hai
carrying capacity par tham jati hai
har waqt ki ikai mein usi nisbat se barhti hai

blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: exponential growth mein population bila had, har waqt ki ikai mein usi nisbat se barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: the population increases by the same ratio per unit time

blocks.prompt:
61 The growth curve of the logistic growth model is:
(Logistic growth model ki growth curve ki shakal:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: logistic growth carrying capacity par tham jati hai, is liye curve sigmoid (S shakal) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: growth curves assume a sigmoid, or flattened S, shape

blocks.prompt:
62 The number of E. coli bacteria per milliliter in a test tube is an example of:
(Test tube mein fi milliliter E. coli bacteria ki tadaad kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: population density fi ikai raqba ya hajm afraad ki tadaad hai.

book_ref.quote: Population density is the number of individuals per unit area or volume

blocks.prompt:
63 When high-density populations approach carrying capacity, severe competition leads to:
(Ghani population jab carrying capacity ke qareeb ho to sakht muqabla kis taraf le jata hai?)

options.text: paidaish kam aur maut ka khatra zyada

blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: sakht muqable se sharah-e-paidaish ghatti aur maut ka khatra barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: leading to decreased birth rate and increased risk of mortality

blocks.prompt:
64 Which dispersion pattern is not common in nature and occurs in some plants with wind-dispersed seeds?
(Kaun sa phelao fitrat mein aam nahi aur hawa se bikharne wale beejon wale paudon mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: random spacing aam nahi; afraad aapas mein zyada amal nahi karte.

book_ref.quote: It is not common in nature

blocks.prompt:
65 Nesting penguins that maintain defined territories show:
(Apne ilaqe qaim rakhne wale ghonsla banate penguins kaun sa phelao dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: ilaqa qaim rakhne wale janwar jaise penguins uniform phelao dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: such as nesting penguins, also exhibit uniform dispersion

blocks.prompt:
66 Clumped spacing is common in nature because individuals:
(Clumped spacing fitrat mein aam kyun hai?)

options.text: wasail wali jagah pasand karte hain

blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: wasail ki na-barabar taqseem se afraad wasail wali jagah par jama hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Clumped spacing is common in nature

blocks.prompt:
67 Which is a limiting factor that determines carrying capacity?
(Carrying capacity ka taayun karne wala limiting factor kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: limiting factors khurak, paani, panah, ghonslon ki jagah, shikari aur bimariyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Carrying capacity is determined by "limiting factors"

blocks.prompt:
68 The smallest number of individuals required for a population to survive and persist is the:
(Population ke bachne aur qaim rehne ke liye kam se kam zaroori tadaad:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: is had se neeche population ko nasl khatam hone ka bara khatra hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The minimal viable population size is the smallest number of individuals required

blocks.prompt:
69 In a very small population like the few remaining Himalayan Brown Bears, inbreeding leads to:
(Himalayan Brown Bears jaisi bohat chhoti population mein inbreeding ka nateeja:)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: inbreeding se genetic kamzoriyan aur bimariyon ke khilaf kam immunity.

book_ref.quote: like the few remaining Himalayan Brown Bears in Pakistan

blocks.prompt:
70 The global human population reached 8 billion in:
(Duniya ki aabadi 8 arab kab hui?)
blocks.explanation: Section 25.4: 2022 mein 8 arab hui; 9 arab taqreeban 2037 tak.

book_ref.quote: In 2022, it reached 8 billion

blocks.prompt:
71 Changes in technology since the early 1700s allowed humans to:
(1700s ke shuru se technology ki tabdeeliyon ne insanon ko kya karne diya?)

options.text: mausam ke aage zyada kamzor hona
apne habitat ki carrying capacity barhana
